blocks.text: The Incidents page is your starting point for investigating and remediating threats. From this page, you can review a list of all incidents and select one to see a detailed breakdown.
On an incident's detail page, you can:

blocks.item: Review the current verdict and findings and get suggestions for next steps.
See which assets and users are impacted.
Visualize the threat's progression chronologically and across the MITRE ATT&CK matrix.
Examine individual investigative leads and review how they confirm or eliminate potential threat paths.
Coordinate with other analysts by adding comments.
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC.
In the left-side navigation, click Incidents.
On the Incidents page, click an incident in the table.

blocks.text: On the incident's detail page, you can view the following tabs:

blocks.item: Details: Summarizes the activity included in the incident, including the current status of the investigation, any verdict reached so far, and AI-recommended response actions to remediate the incident (if applicable).
Affected Entities: Lists the assets and users involved in the incident.
Timeline: Displays the chronological order of events included in the incident.
Attack Path: Overlays events on the MITRE ATT&CK matrix, helping you visualize how an adversary might be progressing through an attack chain.
Analysis: Summarizes the investigative leads explored by the Investigation Agent.
Alerts: Shows which alerts and sources Agentic SOC's Enrichment and Correlation Agents used to create the incident.
Activity: Shows an audit log of all activities related to the incident (e.g., user action, sync from third-party systems).
Comments: Shows all comments added by analysts.
